status: Upstream elekloader core-dt2 1.0 for Digitakt II OS 1.17. Modwerk integration and publication qualification are in progress.

events.name: ev_tick
events.when: the UI compose check, approximately 30 Hz
events.handler: void f(void *ctrl); set ctrl + 0x20 to 1 to request redraw; not an audio-rate clock

events.name: ev_draw
events.when: after the OS composes the 128x64 screen

events.name: ev_key
events.handler: int f(void *brain, void *event); nonzero consumes the event

events.name: ev_enc
events.handler: int f(void *brain, void *event); nonzero consumes the event

tables.name: core_fast
tables.purpose: Copy-table entries used to move linked .fast code into the Digitakt II SRAM tail on the first UI tick.

exports.name: core_additem
exports.purpose: Add a SETTINGS or PERSONALIZE row from the corresponding event handler.
